reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Wyoming
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their gender identity?

    This program encodes ONLY the provided statutes:
      - WY Stat  1-21-1302 (2021) (definitions, limited relevance here)
      - WY Stat  1-21-1303 (2021) (victim-status termination prohibition)
      - WY Stat  40-26-103 (2021) (fair housing protected classes: race, color, religion, sex, disability, familial status, national origin)
*/

% -------------------------
% Scenario facts (question)
% -------------------------

scenario_state(wyoming).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% Parties and dwelling in the scenario.
scenario_landlord(landlord1).
scenario_tenant(tenant1).
scenario_dwelling(dwelling1).

% The landlord evicts the tenant from the dwelling.
scenario_action(evict, landlord1, tenant1, dwelling1).

% The eviction is because of the tenant's gender identity.
scenario_because_of(evict, tenant1, gender_identity).

% Helper predicate: succeeds when the scenario as stated is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(wyoming),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_landlord(L),
    scenario_tenant(T),
    scenario_dwelling(D),
    scenario_action(evict, L, T, D),
    scenario_because_of(evict, T, gender_identity).

% -----------------------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic core)
% -----------------------------------------

/* WY Stat  1-21-1302 (2021) - Definitions (minimal encoding)
   We encode definitional categories used by  1-21-1303.
*/
statute_wy_1_21_1302_def(domestic_abuse).
statute_wy_1_21_1302_def(sexual_violence).
statute_wy_1_21_1302_def(landlord).
statute_wy_1_21_1302_def(tenant).

/* WY Stat  1-21-1303(c) (2021)
   "A landlord may not terminate a tenancy based solely on the tenant's (or household member's)
    status as a victim of domestic abuse or sexual violence."
*/
statute_wy_1_21_1303c_prohibits_termination_based_solely_on_victim_status(domestic_abuse).
statute_wy_1_21_1303c_prohibits_termination_based_solely_on_victim_status(sexual_violence).

/* WY Stat  40-26-103 (2021)
   Protected classes enumerated in the statute.
*/
statute_wy_40_26_103_protected_class(race).
statute_wy_40_26_103_protected_class(color).
statute_wy_40_26_103_protected_class(religion).
statute_wy_40_26_103_protected_class(sex).
statute_wy_40_26_103_protected_class(disability).
statute_wy_40_26_103_protected_class(familial_status).
statute_wy_40_26_103_protected_class(national_origin).

/* WY Stat  40-26-103(a) (2021)
   A person may not "in any other manner make unavailable or deny a dwelling" because of a protected class.

   We treat eviction/termination as making the dwelling unavailable to the tenant.
*/
statute_wy_40_26_103a_action_makes_unavailable(evict).
statute_wy_40_26_103a_action_makes_unavailable(terminate_tenancy).

/* WY Stat  40-26-103(a) (2021)
   Unlawful if: action makes unavailable/denies + because of protected class.
*/
statute_wy_40_26_103a_unlawful_make_unavailable_because_of(Action, Person, ProtectedClass) :-
    statute_wy_40_26_103a_action_makes_unavailable(Action),
    statute_wy_40_26_103_protected_class(ProtectedClass),
    because_of(Action, Person, ProtectedClass).

/* WY Stat  1-21-1303(c) (2021)
   Unlawful if: termination/eviction based solely on victim status (domestic abuse or sexual violence).
   We model "based solely on" by requiring a single stated reason.
*/
statute_wy_1_21_1303c_unlawful_termination_based_solely_on_victim_status(Action, Person, Status) :-
    ( Action = evict ; Action = terminate_tenancy ),
    statute_wy_1_21_1303c_prohibits_termination_based_solely_on_victim_status(Status),
    solely_because_of(Action, Person, Status).

% -------------------------
% Generic reasoning helpers
% -------------------------

% In this self-contained program, "because_of/3" is derived from the scenario facts.
because_of(Action, Person, Trait) :-
    scenario_because_of(Action, Person, Trait).

% "Solely because of" means that the program has exactly one reason recorded for that action/person.
solely_because_of(Action, Person, Trait) :-
    because_of(Action, Person, Trait),
    \+ (because_of(Action, Person, OtherTrait), OtherTrait \= Trait).

% -------------------------
% Unlawful eviction analysis
% -------------------------

% Unlawful eviction if it violates either provided statutory prohibition.
unlawful_eviction_under_provided_statutes :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_action(Action, _L, T, _D),
    (
        statute_wy_40_26_103a_unlawful_make_unavailable_because_of(Action, T, _ProtectedClass)
    ;
        statute_wy_1_21_1303c_unlawful_termination_based_solely_on_victim_status(Action, T, _VictimStatus)
    ).

% -------------------------
% Answer (deterministic)
% -------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    unlawful_eviction_under_provided_statutes,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their gender identity?
